case.summary: Case CASE-013 (Card SC-03013-K951): The real-time risk model scored transaction 4012175 at 0.89, triggering review [EV-02ae78a6]. The transaction originated from a new device profile (Mac OS X 10_15_5 Firefox 89.0) and an anonymous proxy connection from Argentina [EV-26878aa7, EV-bd746ebe]. The card SC-03013-K951 had one prior transaction averaging $290.54 and two online transactions within 48 hours of the flagged transaction [EV-1982ea45, EV-c82a1bfe]. The same device profile appeared in a prior confirmed fraud case, and the customer has one prior fraud case CC-4322 [EV-e24715cf, EV-ef4d0d2e]. The customer reported they did not make the purchases and still possess the card [EV-239568b8]. Six prior closed cases share the card_not_present_new_device pattern [EV-9cb41405].

sar.narrative: Suspicious Activity Report for CASE-013 involving card-not-present fraud on card SC-03013-K951 with exposure of $807.36 across transactions 4012175 and 4012176. The triggering transaction 4012175 for $516.82 was scored at 0.89 by the real-time risk model and originated from a previously unseen device profile (Mac OS X 10_15_5 Firefox 89.0) via an anonymous proxy connection from Argentina [EV-02ae78a6, EV-26878aa7, EV-bd746ebe]. The card exhibited anomalous velocity with two online transactions within 48 hours, deviating from the historical average of $290.54 per transaction [EV-1982ea45, EV-c82a1bfe]. The device fingerprint has been linked to a prior confirmed fraud case, and the customer SC-03013 has a previous fraud case CC-4322 [EV-e24715cf, EV-ef4d0d2e]. The customer confirmed they did not authorize the transactions and retain physical possession of the card [EV-239568b8]. Pattern analysis retrieved six prior closed cases with the same card_not_present_new_device signature, supporting a recurring modus operandi [EV-9cb41405]. The investigation concluded with a fraud verdict and the case is closed.
